       /\ last = "none"

ReadLock == \E b \in Banks : banks[b] = "idle"
Next == \/ ReadLock /\ banks' = [b \in Banks | -> IF b = "idle" THEN "idle"
                                            ELSE IF banks[b] = "idle"
                                            /\ \E b0 \in Banks : banks[b0] = "idle"
                                            /\ UNCHANGED ~b
                                            THEN "idle"
                                            ELSE "idle"
                                            /\ UNCHanged ~b)
                 /\ ledger' = ledger
                 /\ lock' = UNCHANGED ~lock
                 /\ last' = UNCHANGED ~last)
       \/ \E b \in Banks : b # "idle"

                      /\ \E b0 \in {b \in Banks : banks[b] # "idle"}

                                                      /\ \E b0 \in Bank : banks[b0] = "posting"
                                                      /\ \E b0 \ in Bank : banks[b0] = UNCHANGED ~b
                                                      /\ ledger' = "none"
                                                      /\ UNCHANGED ~b)
                                          ELSE UNCHANGED ~b)
                 /\ ledger' # "none"
                 /\ UNCHANGED ~lock)
       \/ \E b \ in Banks : b # "idle"
                          /\ banks[b] # "idle"

       \/ \E b \in Bank : b # "idle"
                          # banks[b]
                          /\ UNCHANGED ~banks)
       \/ \E b \i Banks : b # "idle"
                            /\ banks[b]
                            /\ UNCHANGED ~banks)
  /\ ledger' = ledger
  /\ UNCHANGED ~lock)
  /\ UNCHANGED ~last)
  /\ UNCHANGED ~banks)
Reboot == \E b \in Banks :
                 /\ b # "idle"
                 /\ banks' = [b \ in Banks | -> IF b = b
                                                     /\ banks[b] = "idle"
                                                     /\ UNCHANGED ~b)
                                             ELSE "idle"
                                             /\ UNCHANGED ~b)
                 # banks)
  /\ UNCHANGED ~ledger)
  /\ UNCHANGED ~lock)
